s1_gayatri: oṃ bhūr bhuvaḥ suvaḥ | tat savitur vareṇyaṃ | bhargo devasya dhīmahi | dhiyo yo naḥ pracodayāt ||
s2_apohistha: āpo hiṣṭhā mayobhuvaḥ | tā na ūrje dadhātana | maheraṇāya cakṣase |
s3_kesava: keśavāya namaḥ | nārāyaṇāya namaḥ | mādhavāya namaḥ | govindāya namaḥ | viṣṇave namaḥ | madhusūdanāya namaḥ | trivikramāya namaḥ | vāmanāya namaḥ | śrīdharāya namaḥ | hṛṣīkeśāya namaḥ | padmanābhāya namaḥ | dāmodarāya namaḥ
s5_yajur: oṃ bhūrbhuvassuvaḥ | namaggṃ te rudra manyava utota iṣave namaḥ | te'stu | kḷptaṃ | saṃskṛtaṃ sam̐skṛtam | gaṅgā | namo'stu | ḷ vowel: kḷpta | candrabindu: sam̐śayaḥ
